ovn_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for OVSDB operations before timeout

enable_l3.description: Enable L3 routing and NAT services in OVN

enable_qos.description: Enable QoS policy support (bandwidth limiting, DSCP marking)

enable_metadata.description: Enable Neutron metadata service via OVN metadata proxy

metadata_network.description: UUID of the dedicated metadata network; leave empty to auto-generate

metadata_proxy_user_namespace.description: User namespace for metadata proxy containers (e.g., 'neutron' namespace in Kubernetes)

chassis_type.description: Tunnel type used for overlay networks (geneve, vxlan, or local for flat networks)

l3_scheduler_workers.description: Number of worker processes for L3 scheduling (e.g., router placement)

metadata_workers.description: Number of worker processes for metadata proxy

l3_ha.description: Enable high availability for L3 routers via OVN NAT HA (requires distributed gateway)

max_l3_ha_router_versions.description: Maximum number of L3 HA router versions retained per gateway

enable_ipv6.description: Enable native IPv6 support in OVN (DHCPv6, SLAAC, etc.)

enable_multicast.description: Enable OVN native multicast replication (improves efficiency for broadcast/multicast traffic)

enable_qos_burst.description: Enable burst traffic shaping in QoS rules

enable_ovn_monitor.description: Enable OVSDB monitor mode (auto-reconnect when DB is unavailable)

ovn_connection_inactivity_probe.description: Time in seconds to wait for OVSDB activity before probing connection health

ovn_nb_ssl_key.description: Path to private key for OVN NB SSL/TLS (optional)

ovn_nb_ssl_cert.description: Path to certificate for OVN NB SSL/TLS (optional)

ovn_nb_ssl_cacert.description: Path to CA certificate for OVN NB SSL/TLS (optional)

ovn_sb_ssl_key.description: Path to private key for OVN SB SSL/TLS (optional)

ovn_sb_ssl_cert.description: Path to certificate for OVN SB SSL/TLS (optional)

ovn_sb_ssl_cacert.description: Path to CA certificate for OVN SB SSL/TLS (optional)

bridge_mappings.description: List of physical network to OVS bridge mappings (for flat/VLAN networks)

bridge.description: Name of the OVS bridge to bind the physical network to

vni_ranges.description: List of VNI ranges for tenant networks (e.g., '1:1000' for VXLAN/Geneve)

ovn_dns_servers.description: List of DNS server IP addresses for DHCPv4/v6 (if not using internal DNS)

gateway_chassis.description: List of gateway chassis with priorities (for L3 HA/distributed routing)

name.description: Name of the chassis (e.g., hostname or chassis-id)

priority.description: Chassis priority (higher = preferred for gateway placement)

enable_chassis_as_gw.description: Enable automatic assignment of chassis as gateways for distributed L3

interconn_host.description: Hostname or IP of remote OVN interconnection NB/SB (for multi-site setups)

interconn_nb_port.description: Port for remote OVN NB interconnection

interconn_sb_port.description: Port for remote OVN SB interconnection

nat_external_ip_pool.description: CIDR pool used for floating IPs (e.g., '203.0.113.0/24'); omit for auto-allocation

log_file.description: Path to log file for OVN agent

log_level.description: Logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)
